description: A small IPv4 stack for a Gigabit Ethernet PHY on RGMII at 1000 Mbit/s (the Kintex-7 Eco R5's RTL8211E), in one core (eth_rgmii_phy and eth_udp_core): MAC, MDIO setup (1000 only) and link watch, ARP and ping answered on their own, and UDP on one port for the design, every part a byte a clock. The byte side on a 125 MHz system clock. AMD Xilinx 7-series only. The same design-side ports as eth_udp_stack.

de.description: Ein kleiner IPv4-Stack für einen Gigabit-Ethernet-PHY an RGMII bei 1000 Mbit/s (der RTL8211E des Kintex-7 Eco R5), in einem Kern (eth_rgmii_phy und eth_udp_core): MAC, MDIO-Einrichtung (nur 1000) und Link-Überwachung, ARP und Ping beantwortet er selbst, und UDP auf einem Port für das Design, jeder Teil ein Byte je Takt. Die Byte-Seite an einem 125-MHz-Systemtakt. Nur AMD Xilinx 7-Serie. Dieselben Ports auf der Design-Seite wie eth_udp_stack.
de.name: Ethernet-UDP-Stack (RGMII)

name: Ethernet UDP stack (RGMII)

parameters.description: The UDP port received on and sent from
parameters.name: PORT

parameters.description: The system clock in Hz (125 MHz)

parameters.description: The PHY's MDIO address (from its straps)
parameters.name: PHY_ADDR

parameters.description: Milliseconds before the first MDIO transaction
parameters.name: SETTLE_MS

parameters.description: eth_rgmii_phy's: which clock edge starts a received byte

ports.description: RGMII RX_CLK from the PHY (125 MHz)

ports.description: MDIO's value while mdio_oe is high

ports.description: MDIO as it is (the pin, with a pull-up)

ports.description: Pulses for each frame with a good FCS (to anyone)

ports.description: Pulses for each frame with a bad FCS or an error from the PHY

ports.description: Pulses when an ARP reply is queued

ports.description: Pulses when an echo reply is queued
ports.name: ping_replied

ports.description: Bytes in the datagram handed over
ports.name: rx_length

ports.description: Pulses when a datagram is handed over
ports.name: rx_new

ports.description: Pulses when a datagram was dropped (the one before wasn't taken yet)
